title: The Fall
subtitle: The same flag, taken away
description: A stage reward sets a flag; the same reward with `"remove": true`
clears it. This is how a pack closes a door it opened -- a fall from
grace, a revoked rank, a chapter that ends by sending you back out.
The checkmark is the acknowledgement, and it is the one task here you
hand in by hand: everything else in the chapter is counted as you carry
it, and this one waits for you to say you are going.
